confirmed_cause: The workflow requires secrets.AIDREAM_REPO_TOKEN to read the pinned private AI-Matrix-Engine/aidream source, but the matrx-extend repository currently has zero Actions secrets. The pinned aidream commit exists. This is missing credential provisioning, not a demonstrated records-guide or product-code failure.

github_app_route.existing_installation: Safe users.integration_connection_resources metadata shows AI-Matrix-Engine/aidream under AI Matrx Admin installation 162010875 with contents:write granted to the installation.
github_app_route.technical_capability: GitHub permits an installation token restricted to one repository and contents:read, expiring after one hour. Its documented creation requires an App JWT signed with an App private key. Sources: https://docs.github.com/en/apps/creating-github-apps/authenticating-with-a-github-app/authenticating-as-a-github-app-installation and https://github.com/actions/create-github-app-token/blob/main/README.md.
github_app_route.current_platform_state: The documented first-party connection and aidream github_integrations source issue per-user OAuth tokens using GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET. No installation-token mint broker, App private-key configuration name, or create-github-app-token workflow was found in the inspected canonical integration, aidream service/workflows, or matrx-extend workflow. Existing local aidream .env key names include GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET, but no App private-key name; values were not read. matrx-extend Actions has zero repository secrets.
github_app_route.verdict: The existing installation can support a least-privilege CI reader after App-private-key provisioning and a workflow mint step, but there is no already configured, documented broker path that can issue that token now. An OAuth client secret or generic PAT is not an App private key.

existing_vault_pat_scope_audit.verdict: Unmeasured: metadata does not establish whether a generic Vault PAT can read only AI-Matrix-Engine/aidream. No candidate token was used.
existing_vault_pat_scope_audit.secure_delivery_boundary: aidream/api/mcp/agent_service/secure_delivery_tools.py sends a sealed item to a person by a one-time link and returns a value-free receipt; it has no GitHub permission-inspection operation. It explicitly refuses MCP disclosure of Vault passwords/tokens that need recent human sign-in.
existing_vault_pat_scope_audit.broker_boundary: aidream/services/token_broker/minters has no GitHub audience or Vault-PAT scope inspector; registered minters are provider-specific and do not test a stored GitHub credential.
existing_vault_pat_scope_audit.sandbox_boundary: The hosted sandbox can inject a user's selected Vault environment values into that sandbox and has a GitHub credential helper, but its helper prefers the user's GitHub App OAuth connection over the user's GITHUB_TOKEN fallback. This task has no attached hosted sandbox execution tool or approved candidate-bound inspection door; a generic git success there would not establish which credential was used or its full scope.
existing_vault_pat_scope_audit.missing_capability: An authorized server-side operation must select a specific Vault field, call GitHub with it inside the trusted process, and return only the candidate identity plus a bounded repository/permission verdict. No such existing operation or callable tool was found. Direct Vault reveal, SQL decryption, process-environment export, or local broad gh authentication would expose or substitute the credential and was not used.

safe_remediation: Provision a dedicated GitHub credential limited to contents:read on AI-Matrix-Engine/aidream, approved for this CI purpose, then set it as AIDREAM_REPO_TOKEN on armanisadeghi/matrx-extend Actions with repository access confirmed. Rerun the exact failed workflow at a new commit/ref and inspect its first failing step. Do not replace it with the broad operator token, suppress the preflight, or treat this run as a code-test verdict.
